title: Trusted by teams running controlled document workflows
description: See how teams use DocKosha to keep sensitive document workflows organized, controlled, and easy to share.

items.quote:
I first tried DocSend, and thought it was a very nice way to share my PDFs to my customers. However, once trial ended, I discovered the prices that were wayyyy too high. After some research, I found DocKosha, which meets all my requirements with a very low price (compared to DocSend), and is easier to use.

Support team has been very helpful. I suggested to be able to pick the language for customer side, and the feature has been added within a few days ! Didn't expect anything that quick !
items.name: Lucas
